executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
assert not OUT.exists(),'E39来源资格已登记，不能重启。'
ref='reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1'
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/(ref+'/next_experiment.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E39' and proposal['fixed_stat_months']==['2024-01','2024-02','2024-03']
parents=[ref+'/next_experiment.json',ref+'/protocol.json',ref+'/result.json',ref+'/source_gate.json',
ref+'/下一方向选择_工业经营金额旧用途有限定位.json',ref+'/下一方向选择_用电实物量旧用途有限定位.json',
'reports/research/510300_industrial_profit_response_v1/result.json',
'research/orders_cost_profit_bridge_v21.py','research/real_activity_followthrough_v17.py',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/result.json']
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
OUT.mkdir()
proto={'study_id':'510300_ELECTRICITY_PHYSICAL_QUANTITY_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E39',
 'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'status':'SOURCE_ONLY_REGISTERED_BEFORE_PUBLIC_SEARCH_OR_NEW_QUANTITY_EXTRACTION',
 'prior_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E38_NEW_OFFICIAL_ORIGINAL_FACTS_AND_SOURCE_GATE_NOT_ADMITTED',
 'question':proposal['question'],'mechanism_and_limits':proposal['mechanism_and_limits'],
 'source_difference':proposal['why_distinct'],'fixed_stat_months':proposal['fixed_stat_months'],
 'candidate_source':proposal['candidate_source'],'desired_fields':proposal['desired_original_fields'],
 'parents':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p),'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size} for p in parents],
 'source_gate':proposal['source_gate'],
 'strict_no_substitutions':['发电量不替代用电量','累计量不冒充单月量','不同版本累计差额不拼单月','能源操作量不替代DR成交额','工业调查总体不当CSI300盈利总体'],
 'clock':'统计月/页面显示发布时间/当前实际收件/URL日期分别保存；不从当前网页认证原不可变首版，不把当前收件回填到2024。',
 'cause_reason_requirement':'原文直接解释或独立原因数据才归类；纯数量同比不证明原因，气温/工作日/能效/行业结构缺证据UNKNOWN。',
 'fresh_prior_use_check':'登记后只复核当前research/config中明确用电原字段，同词匹配不证明用途相同；未穷尽全历史版本。',
 'budget':proposal['budget'],'budget_counting':'每个search_query的q计1；原官方页每次HTTP GET计1，重定向不自动跟随，不重试/另取目录。',
 'stop':proposal['stop'],
 'model_followup':'本实验没有模型阶段。有限来源通过也没有完整原训练支持或账户准入；需要另立不同问题，不自动扩全年/拟合。',
 'goal_achieved':False,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'live_process':False,
 'dr007':'用户暂无有效访问，E34条件保持，0带凭据提供方请求，不重试到期配置。'}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'registered':proto['study_id'],'fixed_months':proto['fixed_stat_months'],
 'parent_count':len(parents),'budget':proto['budget']},ensure_ascii=False))
